# Asteroid Dodge

A simple HTML canvas game where the player pilots a spaceship across a scrolling starfield, dodging randomly spawned asteroids. The ship can collect fuel canisters to extend play. **Lose condition:** Collision with an asteroid or running out of fuel ends the game.

1: // game.js – simple Asteroid Dodge
2: // Assumes an HTML canvas with id="game"
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return;
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
9:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
10:   // Audio context and simple tone generator
11:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
12:   function playTone(freq, duration) {
13:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
14:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
15:     osc.type = 'sine';
16:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
17:     osc.connect(gain);
18:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
19:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
20:     osc.start();
21:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
22:   }
23: 
24:   // ---- Game state ----
25:   // Ship object
26:   let ship = { x: width / 2, y: height - 60, w: 40, h: 40, speed: 5 };
27:   // Asteroids with rotation
28:   let asteroids = [];
29:   // Fuel canisters
30:   let fuels = [];
31:   // Fuel percentage
32:   let fuel = 100; // percent
33:   let score = 0;
34:   let gameOver = false;
35:   const asteroidSpawnRate = 0.02; // per frame
36:   const fuelSpawnRate = 0.001;
37:   // Simple moving starfield
38:   let stars = [];
39:   const STAR_COUNT = 120;
40:   for (let i = 0; i < STAR_COUNT; i++) {
41:     stars.push({ x: Math.random() * width, y: Math.random() * height, speed: 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5 });
42:   }
43: 
44:   // ---- Input handling ----
45:   const keys = {};
46:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
47:     if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
48:     keys[e.key] = true;
49:   });
50:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
51: 
52:   function update() {
53:     if (gameOver) return;
54:     // move ship
55:     if (keys['ArrowLeft'] && ship.x > 0) ship.x -= ship.speed;
56:     if (keys['ArrowRight'] && ship.x + ship.w < width) ship.x += ship.speed;
57:     if (keys['ArrowUp'] && ship.y > 0) ship.y -= ship.speed;
58:     if (keys['ArrowDown'] && ship.y + ship.h < height) ship.y += ship.speed;
59: 
60:     // spawn asteroids
61:     if (Math.random() < asteroidSpawnRate) {
62:       const size = 20 + Math.random() * 30;
63:       asteroids.push({
64:         x: Math.random() * (width - size),
65:         y: -size,
66:         w: size,
67:         h: size,
68:         speed: 2 + Math.random() * 3,
69:         rotation: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
70:         rotSpeed: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.05
71:       });
72:     }
73:     // spawn fuel canisters
74:     if (Math.random() < fuelSpawnRate) {
75:       const s = 20;
76:       fuels.push({ x: Math.random() * (width - s), y: -s, w: s, h: s, speed: 2 });
77:     }
78: 
79:     // move asteroids, rotate them, and fuels
80:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
81:       a.y += a.speed;
82:       a.rotation += a.rotSpeed;
83:     });
84:     fuels.forEach(f => f.y += f.speed);
85:     // update starfield
86:     stars.forEach(st => {
87:       st.y += st.speed;
88:       if (st.y > height) {
89:         st.y = 0;
90:         st.x = Math.random() * width;
91:       }
92:     });
93:     // remove off‑screen
94:     asteroids = asteroids.filter(a => a.y < height);
95:     fuels = fuels.filter(f => f.y < height);
96: 
97:     // fuel consumption
98:     fuel -= 0.05;
99:     if (fuel <= 0) gameOver = true;
100: 
101:     // collisions
102:     for (const a of asteroids) {
103:       if (rectsIntersect(ship, a)) {
104:         gameOver = true;
105:         playTone(150, 0.3); // crash sound
106:         break;
107:       }
108:     }
109:     for (let i = fuels.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
110:       if (rectsIntersect(ship, fuels[i])) {
111:         fuel = Math.min(100, fuel + 30);
112:         fuels.splice(i, 1);
113:         score += 10;
114:         playTone(300, 0.1); // fuel collect sound
115:       }
116:     }
117:     // score based on time
118:     score += 0.1;
119:   }
120: 
121: 
122:   function rectsIntersect(r1, r2) {
123:     return !(r2.x > r1.x + r1.w ||
124:              r2.x + r2.w < r1.x ||
125:              r2.y > r1.y + r1.h ||
126:              r2.y + r2.h < r1.y);
127:   }
128: 
129:   function draw() {
130:     // background gradient (night sky)
131:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height);
132:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
133:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#000');
134:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
135:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
136:     // moving starfield
137:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
138:     stars.forEach(st => ctx.fillRect(st.x, st.y, 2, 2));
139:     // ship – a white triangle
140:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
141:     ctx.beginPath();
142:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y);
143:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x - ship.w / 2, ship.y + ship.h);
144:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w / 2, ship.y + ship.h);
145:     ctx.closePath();
146:     ctx.fill();
147:     // asteroids – rotating gray rocks
148:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
149:       ctx.save();
150:       const cx = a.x + a.w / 2;
151:       const cy = a.y + a.h / 2;
152:       ctx.translate(cx, cy);
153:       ctx.rotate(a.rotation);
154:       // slight colour variation based on size
155:       const shade = Math.floor(150 + (a.w / 80) * 105);
156:       ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${shade},${shade},${shade})`;
157:       ctx.beginPath();
158:       ctx.arc(0, 0, a.w / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
159:       ctx.fill();
160:       ctx.restore();
161:     });
162:     // fuel canisters – green squares
163:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
164:     fuels.forEach(f => ctx.fillRect(f.x, f.y, f.w, f.h));
165:     // HUD
166:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
167:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
168:     ctx.fillText(`Fuel: ${Math.max(0, fuel).toFixed(0)}%`, 10, 20);
169:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${Math.floor(score)}`, 10, 40);
170:     if (gameOver) {
171:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
172:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
173:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
174:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
175:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
176:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
177:     }
178:   }
179: 
180:   function loop() {
181:     if (!gameOver) update();
182:     draw();
183:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
184:   }
185:   loop();
186: })();

(End of file - total 186 lines)
</content>
